name: Sentinel Aynasha
summary: Along Darkshore’s wild borders, Sentinel Aynasha scouts dangers threatening night elven lands. She watches enemy movements and carries urgent intelligence across the frontier.

sections.title: On the Front Lines
sections.body: Sentinel Aynasha scouts and fights with the Sentinels where night elven lands meet hostile incursions. She carries urgent messages across rough country and watches for enemy patrols. Her skill with a bow and knowledge of survival help her cross contested ground.

faq.answer: Sentinel Aynasha scouts and fights as an archer with the night elven Sentinels. They defend northern Kalimdor and its borders.

faq.q: What threats does she monitor in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Along Darkshore’s edges, Sentinel Aynasha watches hostile camps, rogue furbolg tribes, and foreign incursions that threaten the night elf wilderness.

faq.q: Why is she often isolated on the road?
faq.answer: Sentinel Aynasha and other Sentinels often travel alone or in small pairs. They carry urgent intelligence between posts without drawing unwanted attention from hostile forces.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see in Sentinel Aynasha a watchful defender of the ancient woods. She guards them from foreign powers and wild corruption.
As an Alliance traveler in Kalimdor, you may find Sentinel scouts like Aynasha along dangerous wilderness roads. They are vital contacts there.
